name: Local Grove Prepackaged Flower | Alpha Runtz | 3.5G
description: Genetics: Bacio Gelato x Runtz Breeder: Clearwater Genetics Selected by: Local Grove (seed hunt, in-house pheno) Aroma & Flavor: Fresh lemony candy on the plant; cured buds reveal rich chocolate candy gas Effects: Hybrid – uplifting with a sweet, flavorful smoke and relaxing body finish Alpha Runtz is a Local Grove in-house selection from Clearwater Genetics’ Bacio Gelato x Runtz cross. On the grow, the strain gives off a bright lemony candy aroma, but after a careful cure it transforms into a decadent chocolate-candy gas profile.
